hero_sub: Before you trust anyone with your future in this country, you should know who's doing the work. Meet the founder — then ask him about your case.

options: Work or investor visa (E-2, TN, L-1, O-1, H-1B)

problem_cards.title: Big-firm training, boutique attention
problem_cards.body: Corporate immigration firms teach a discipline: complete records, anticipated objections, no surprises. Faragalla Law applies that standard to individual and family cases — with the founder, not a case mill, on your file.

problem_cards.title: Federal practice, nationwide reach
problem_cards.body: Immigration is federal law, which allows the firm to represent clients before USCIS and the immigration courts in all 50 states and abroad — with offices in Texas and Florida and clients worldwide.

problem_cards.title: Straight answers, flat fees
problem_cards.body: You'll hear what's realistic before you pay for anything — including when the honest advice is to wait, strengthen the case, or not file at all. When we do take the case, the fee is flat and quoted up front.
